title: Explainable prediction of MDR/RR-TB in tuberculosis-diabetes mellitus multimorbidity: a machine learning model developed and validated in a dual-center study.
summary: A random forest predicts MDR/RR tuberculosis among patients with TB-diabetes multimorbidity in a dual-center retrospective cohort (n=245); ten-fold CV AUC was 0.818 with recall 0.611, and calibration/DCA were reported. Authors appropriately frame it as triage, not diagnosis.
ai_technology: Seven ML models are fit and explained with SHAP using clinical features.
